messages:
ashley: Hey team, I'm investigating a p95 latency spike in eu-west this morning. Can someone drop the canonical region dashboard + model-health shortlinks? I think I might not have Grafana/Loki perms. cc @eng-platform
ops-bot: Alert posted: high-p95-eu-west · incident id 4728 · see /alerts/4728 · :warning:
maria: Grafana dash: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/YC3kEu/region-overview-eu-west (shortlink) — model health panel is in the lower tabs (section 4). If you can't access, ping eng-platform.
ben: I just tried the link and got a 403. Can someone add ashley to Grafana viewers? @sam-platform
sam: @ben I'll grant view role in ~10m. Ashley, can you confirm your SSO org id so I can add you?
ashley: my SSO is redwood:github:ashley. Getting the same 403 when opening the Loki Explore link too. Any quick Loki query snippets I can try from the console if perms are flaky?
maria: here's a quick Loki query to tail model-serving logs in eu-west — run from Explore or panel datasource = Loki:
```
{cluster="eu-west"} |= "model_serving" | json | line_format "{{.level}} {{.msg}}"
```
should show recent errors/warnings; if you see many "kv cache miss" that's expected during cold cache.
leo: If you're blocked on perms I can screenshot the top panels and paste the top 5 traces. @oncall-bot can you attach the most recent trace id for the p95 spike?
oncall-bot: Trace for spike: trace_id=abcde-12345 · top span service=model-runtime · link: https://tracing.redwood.ai/trace/abcde-12345
tj: quick heads-up — alerting looks noisy because of a canary rollout of quantization-v2 that started last night. tagging @eng-ml in case the model changes caused tail latency.
sam: done — ashley added to Grafana read role and granted Loki Explore read. Also created INF-789 to add infra oncall rotation to the viewing group (so next time you won't need individual adds).
ashley: Confirmed I can open the dashboard now, thanks. Running Maria's Loki query and will paste a short excerpt if I find errors. :thumbsup:
